blocks.text: Balcony App 3.0 beta. Daily crash digest for Tuesday. 41 active testers, 2 new crashes, 1 device.
Crash 1: Android 11 tablet. Screen: camera, while opening. 2:14 pm. Build 3.0 beta 6.
Crash 2: Android 11 tablet. Screen: camera, while opening. 4:51 pm. Build 3.0 beta 6.
Both reports come from the same device and stop at the same line, reading a photo from the cache folder.
Linked fix: android: fix photo cache path on Android 11 (open pull request, not yet in a beta build).
No crashes on any other device in the last 24 hours.
